# March seedlings and the kitchen window

The tomatoes lean towards the glass despite being turned each morning. Started a second tray farther apart instead of buying another lamp. A photograph from above shows the crowding more clearly than the plant labels do. If the second tray grows better, spacing and position will still be confounded. [[Garden notebook]] can hold an uncertain comparison without announcing a discovery.
